description: Defines the JsonKeyInvalidException class, a custom exception indicating invalid JSON key format, including builder methods for creating instances with specific messages and descriptions.

classes.name: JsonKeyInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending JsonRuntimeException, representing an exception for invalid JSON keys, with static builder methods.

classes.name: JsonKeyInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing JsonKeyInvalidException instances, allowing setting of JSON pointer messages.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating JsonKeyInvalidException objects.

methods.name: newBuilderWithDescription
methods.description: Returns a builder preconfigured with a specific JSON key and description.

methods.name: newBuilderWithoutDescription
methods.description: Returns a builder with a default description indicating invalid JSON key.

methods.name: jsonPointer
methods.description: Sets a message pointing to the invalid JSON key, formatting it as 'The JSON key <{jsonKey}> is invalid!'.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Constructs a JsonKeyInvalidException instance with provided error details.
